questions.question: How many layers does the OSI model have?
questions.explanation: The OSI model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, and Application.

questions.question: Which transport protocol is connection-oriented and reliable?
What is the default port number for HTTPS?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses port 443 by default; HTTP uses port 80.

questions.question: A switch forwards frames based on which address?
RIP (Routing Information Protocol) is an example of which routing approach?
questions.explanation: RIP (Routing Information Protocol) is a Distance Vector routing protocol using hop count.

questions.question: Which error detection method is most effective at catching burst errors?
questions.explanation: CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) is the most effective method for detecting burst errors.

questions.question: How many usable host addresses exist in a /24 subnet?
questions.explanation: A /24 subnet has 256 total addresses; subtract 2 (network and broadcast) for 254 usable hosts.
